structures.label: دهلیز راست
structures.description: Receives blood returning from the بدن and passes it to the بطن راست.

structures.label: دهلیز چپ
structures.description: Receives oxygen-rich blood from the ریه‌ها and passes it to the بطن چپ.

structures.label: Ventricular wall
structures.description: Muscular tissue surrounding the two تحتانی pumping chambers of the قلب.

structures.label: راست ventricular cavity
structures.description: The space inside the بطن راست, which pumps blood toward the ریه‌ها.

structures.label: چپ ventricular cavity
structures.description: The space inside the بطن چپ, which pumps blood into the آئورت.

structures.label: Ascending آئورت
structures.description: The آئورت carries blood away from the قلب to the بدن.

structures.label: Aortic arch
structures.description: Part of the آئورت, the main سرخرگ carrying blood from the قلب.

structures.label: ریوی trunk
structures.description: Carries blood from the بطن راست toward the ریه‌ها.

structures.label: فوقانی vena cava
structures.description: One of the large سیاهرگ‌ها returning blood from the بدن to the دهلیز راست.

structures.label: چپ coronary سرخرگ
structures.description: Supplies the قلب ماهیچه, including parts of the چپ قلب and ventricular تیغه.

structures.label: راست coronary سرخرگ
structures.description: Supplies the دهلیز راست and parts of both ventricles.

structures.description: The خلفی part of a مغزی hemisphere and the principal cortical ناحیه for visual processing.

structures.label: راست hippocampus

structures.label: Medulla oblongata

structures.label: Cerebellum

structures.label: راست جانبی ventricle

structures.label: Third ventricle

structures.label: مغزی aqueduct
structures.description: A narrow channel through the midbrain linking the third and fourth ventricles.

structures.label: Fourth ventricle
structures.description: A cavity between the brainstem and cerebellum that receives fluid from the مغزی aqueduct.

structures.label: کبد سطح
structures.description: The کبد processes nutrients, stores energy, and makes bile to help digest fats. It sits beneath the دیافراگم, mostly on the راست سمت of the شکم.

structures.label: کیسهٔ صفرا
structures.description: A small organ beneath the کبد that stores bile between meals and releases it into the رودهٔ باریک to support fat digestion.

structures.label: Portal سیاهرگ
structures.description: The کبدی portal سیاهرگ brings nutrient-rich blood to the کبد from the digestive organs. Its branches distribute this blood through the کبد.

structures.label: کبدی سیاهرگ‌ها
structures.description: The کبدی سیاهرگ‌ها carry blood away from the کبد toward the تحتانی vena cava, returning it to the circulation.

structures.label: کبدی سرخرگ
structures.description: The کبدی سرخرگ supplies oxygenated blood to the کبد, alongside the nutrient-rich blood arriving through the portal سیاهرگ.

structures.label: کبدی bile ducts
structures.description: A branching network collects bile from the کبد. The راست and چپ کبدی ducts join the common کبدی duct.

structures.label: Cystic duct
structures.description: The cystic duct connects the کیسهٔ صفرا with the bile duct دستگاه, providing a passage for stored bile.

structures.label: کلیهٔ راست
structures.description: The patient’s کلیهٔ راست is one of the paired organs that filter blood and produce urine. In this source بدن it sits slightly تحتانی than the کلیهٔ چپ.

structures.label: کلیهٔ چپ
structures.description: The patient’s کلیهٔ چپ is shown in its source alignment beside the ستون مهره‌ها. This سطح mesh does not expose cortex, medulla, or the کلیوی لگن.

structures.label: راست ureter
structures.description: The راست ureter is the narrow muscular tube that carries urine from the کلیهٔ راست toward the مثانه. The مثانه is outside this release’s represented scope.

structures.label: چپ ureter
structures.description: The چپ ureter descends from the کلیهٔ چپ toward the مثانه. Its تحتانی end is truncated here because the مثانه is not included in the selected geometry.

structures.label: راست کلیوی سرخرگ
structures.description: The راست کلیوی سرخرگ supplies the کلیهٔ راست. The source concept combines its represented trunk and mapped branches into one selectable scene object.

structures.label: چپ کلیوی سرخرگ
structures.description: The چپ کلیوی سرخرگ supplies the کلیهٔ چپ. Color is illustrative and is used to distinguish the سرخرگی meshes from adjacent surfaces.

structures.label: معده
structures.description: A muscular J-shaped sac in the فوقانی چپ شکم that stores food, mixes it with digestive juices, and passes it on in small amounts.

structures.label: مری (تحتانی part)
structures.description: The muscular tube that carries swallowed food down through the قفسهٔ سینه. It passes through the دیافراگم and opens into the معده at the cardia.

structures.label: Duodenum
structures.description: The first part of the رودهٔ باریک. It receives food from the معده through the pylorus and curves around the سر of the لوزالمعده.

structures.label: Celiac trunk
structures.description: A short سرخرگ branching from the abdominal آئورت. It divides into the چپ معدی, splenic, and common کبدی سرخرگ‌ها, which supply the معده and its neighbours.

structures.label: چپ معدی سرخرگ
structures.description: The smallest celiac branch. It runs up toward the مری and along the lesser curvature of the معده.

structures.label: Splenic سرخرگ
structures.description: A winding branch running چپ behind the معده along the لوزالمعده to the طحال. Its branches also supply parts of the معده.

structures.label: Common کبدی سرخرگ
structures.description: The celiac branch running راست toward the کبد. Its branches help supply the معده, duodenum, and لوزالمعده.

structures.label: طحال
structures.description: An organ of the immune and blood systems that sits behind and to the چپ of the معده, under the دنده‌ها.

structures.label: لوزالمعده
structures.description: A gland lying behind the معده. It releases digestive juices into the duodenum and hormones such as insulin into the blood.

attribution.credit: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution-Share Alike 2.1 Japan

structures.label: لوزالمعده
structures.description: A gland behind the معده. Its سر sits in the curve of the duodenum and its tail reaches the طحال.

structures.label: Pancreatic duct
structures.description: Carries digestive juices from the gland along its length and empties them into the duodenum.

structures.label: Duodenum
structures.description: The first part of the رودهٔ باریک. It curves around the سر of the لوزالمعده and receives the pancreatic duct.

structures.label: طحال
structures.description: An organ in the فوقانی چپ شکم. The tail of the لوزالمعده ends near its hilum.

structures.label: Celiac trunk
structures.description: A short branch of the آئورت that divides into سرخرگ‌ها supplying the معده, کبد, طحال and لوزالمعده.

structures.label: Common کبدی سرخرگ
structures.description: Runs from the celiac trunk toward the کبد and gives off the gastroduodenal سرخرگ.

structures.label: Gastroduodenal سرخرگ
structures.description: Passes behind the first part of the duodenum and leads to the سرخرگ‌ها around the pancreatic سر.

structures.label: Pancreaticoduodenal سرخرگ‌ها
structures.description: Arcades around the سر of the لوزالمعده that supply it and the duodenum, joining branches from above and below.

structures.label: Splenic سرخرگ
structures.description: Runs from the celiac trunk along the فوقانی border of the لوزالمعده to the طحال.

structures.label: Pancreatic branches
structures.description: Branches that supply the گردن, بدن and tail of the لوزالمعده.

structures.label: فوقانی mesenteric سرخرگ
structures.description: Leaves the آئورت behind the گردن of the لوزالمعده and supplies much of the intestine.

structures.label: Splenic سیاهرگ
structures.description: Drains the طحال and runs behind the لوزالمعده to join the فوقانی mesenteric سیاهرگ.

structures.label: فوقانی mesenteric سیاهرگ
structures.description: Drains much of the intestine. Its چپ border marks where the سر of the لوزالمعده ends and the بدن begins.

structures.label: Portal سیاهرگ
structures.description: Formed behind the گردن of the لوزالمعده where the splenic and فوقانی mesenteric سیاهرگ‌ها meet. It carries blood to the کبد.

structures.label: Pancreaticoduodenal سیاهرگ‌ها
structures.description: Drain the سر of the لوزالمعده and the duodenum toward the portal دستگاه.

attribution.credit: BodyParts3D / Anatomography, © The Database Center for Life Science. CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan. Adapted by OrganUI.

structures.label: طحال
structures.description: The largest lymphatic organ. It filters blood, removes worn-out red blood cells, and helps the immune دستگاه respond to infection.

structures.label: Splenic سرخرگ
structures.description: Carries blood from the celiac trunk along the فوقانی border of the لوزالمعده to the طحال.

structures.label: Splenic سیاهرگ
structures.description: Drains blood from the طحال behind the لوزالمعده. It joins the فوقانی mesenteric سیاهرگ to form the portal سیاهرگ, which carries it to the کبد.

structures.label: Celiac trunk
structures.description: A short branch of the abdominal آئورت that divides to supply the معده, کبد and طحال. The splenic سرخرگ is its largest branch.

structures.label: فوقانی mesenteric سیاهرگ
structures.description: Drains the رودهٔ باریک and joins the splenic سیاهرگ behind the گردن of the لوزالمعده.

structures.label: معده
structures.description: Lies in front of and to the راست of the طحال. The طحال’s front سطح rests against the back of the معده.

structures.label: لوزالمعده
structures.description: Its tail reaches toward the splenic hilum, and the splenic vessels run along its فوقانی border and back.

structures.label: کلیهٔ چپ
structures.description: Sits behind and below the طحال. The طحال’s inner سطح touches the فوقانی part of the کلیهٔ چپ.

structures.label: چپ غدهٔ فوق‌کلیوی
structures.description: A small hormone-producing gland on top of the کلیهٔ چپ, close to the طحال’s inner سطح.

attribution.credit: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution-Share Alike 2.1 Japan

structures.label: کیسهٔ صفرا
structures.description: A pear-shaped sac on the underside of the کبد. It stores and concentrates bile between meals and squeezes it out after eating.

structures.label: Cystic duct
structures.description: A short duct from the گردن of the کیسهٔ صفرا. Bile flows in through it to be stored and back out when the کیسهٔ صفرا contracts.

structures.label: Common کبدی duct
structures.description: Formed where the راست and چپ کبدی ducts meet. It carries bile from the کبد down toward the duodenum.

structures.label: راست کبدی duct
structures.description: Drains bile from the راست part of the کبد. It is short in this model.

structures.label: چپ کبدی duct
structures.description: Drains bile from the چپ part of the کبد and runs across to meet the راست کبدی duct.

structures.label: Intrahepatic bile ducts
structures.description: Branches inside the کبد that collect bile from its segments and lead to the راست and چپ کبدی ducts.

structures.label: Pancreatic duct
structures.description: Runs the length of the لوزالمعده. It usually joins the common bile duct just before both open into the duodenum.

structures.label: کبد
structures.description: Makes bile and drains it through the کبدی ducts. The کیسهٔ صفرا lies in a shallow fossa on its underside.

structures.label: Duodenum
structures.description: The first part of the رودهٔ باریک. Bile and pancreatic juice enter it through the major duodenal papilla.

structures.label: لوزالمعده
structures.description: A gland behind the معده. The تحتانی common bile duct passes through or behind its سر.

structures.label: Portal سیاهرگ
structures.description: Carries blood from the gut and طحال to the کبد. It runs behind the bile duct and the کبدی سرخرگ.

structures.label: Common کبدی سرخرگ
structures.description: Runs from the celiac trunk toward the کبد and continues as the کبدی سرخرگ proper.

structures.label: کبدی سرخرگ proper
structures.description: Climbs beside the bile duct toward the کبد and divides into the راست and چپ کبدی سرخرگ‌ها.

structures.label: راست کبدی سرخرگ
structures.description: Supplies the راست part of the کبد. The cystic سرخرگ to the کیسهٔ صفرا usually arises from it.

structures.label: چپ کبدی سرخرگ
structures.description: Supplies the چپ part of the کبد.

structures.label: مثانه
structures.description: A hollow, balloon-shaped muscular organ in the لگن that stores urine until it is released.

structures.label: راست ureter
structures.description: A narrow muscular tube that carries urine from the کلیهٔ راست down to the مثانه.

structures.label: چپ ureter
structures.description: A narrow muscular tube that carries urine from the کلیهٔ چپ down to the مثانه.

structures.label: Urethra
structures.description: The tube that lets urine leave the بدن from the bottom of the مثانه.

structures.label: Prostate
structures.description: A walnut-sized gland that sits just below the مثانه and surrounds the first part of the urethra.

structures.label: راست seminal vesicle
structures.description: A small gland behind the مثانه that adds fluid to semen. It lies close to the مثانه’s back wall.

structures.label: چپ seminal vesicle
structures.description: A small gland behind the مثانه that adds fluid to semen. It lies close to the مثانه’s back wall.

structures.label: راست pubococcygeus
structures.description: Part of the pelvic floor ماهیچه‌ها, which support the مثانه and help hold urine in until it is released.

structures.label: چپ pubococcygeus
structures.description: Part of the pelvic floor ماهیچه‌ها, which support the مثانه and help hold urine in until it is released.

structures.label: راست puborectalis
structures.description: Part of the pelvic floor ماهیچه‌ها. It forms a sling that loops behind the تحتانی rectum.

structures.label: چپ puborectalis
structures.description: Part of the pelvic floor ماهیچه‌ها. It forms a sling that loops behind the تحتانی rectum.

structures.label: Rectum
structures.description: The last part of the رودهٔ بزرگ, which stores stool. It lies behind the مثانه and prostate.

structures.label: قرنیه
structures.description: The clear, curved front window of the چشم. It lets light in and does most of the focusing.

structures.label: Sclera
structures.description: The tough white outer coat of the کرهٔ چشم. It protects the چشم and anchors the چشم ماهیچه‌ها.

structures.label: Choroid
structures.description: A layer rich in رگ‌های خونی between the sclera and the شبکیه that nourishes the outer شبکیه.

structures.label: شبکیه
structures.description: The light-sensitive lining at the back of the چشم. It turns light into signals sent along the عصب بینایی.

structures.label: عنبیه
structures.description: The coloured ring behind the قرنیه. Its ماهیچه‌ها change the size of the مردمک to control how much light enters.

structures.label: قدامی chamber
structures.description: The fluid-filled space between the قرنیه and the عنبیه. Its clear fluid, the aqueous humour, keeps the چشم’s shape.

structures.label: عدسی
structures.description: A clear, flexible ساختار behind the عنبیه that fine-tunes focus for near and far objects.

structures.label: Suspensory رباط of عدسی
structures.description: Fine fibres that hold the عدسی in place. Changes in their tension let the عدسی change shape to focus.

structures.label: Vitreous بدن
structures.description: The clear gel that fills the large space behind the عدسی and helps hold the چشم’s shape.

structures.label: فوقانی rectus
structures.description: One of the six ماهیچه‌ها that move the چشم. It mainly turns the چشم upward.

structures.label: تحتانی rectus
structures.description: One of the six ماهیچه‌ها that move the چشم. It mainly turns the چشم downward.

structures.label: داخلی rectus
structures.description: One of the six ماهیچه‌ها that move the چشم. It turns the چشم inward, toward the بینی.

structures.label: جانبی rectus
structures.description: One of the six ماهیچه‌ها that move the چشم. It turns the چشم outward, away from the بینی.

structures.label: فوقانی oblique
structures.description: An چشم ماهیچه whose زردپی passes through a small pulley, the trochlea, before reaching the کرهٔ چشم. It mainly rotates the چشم and helps it look down and out.

structures.label: تحتانی oblique
structures.description: An چشم ماهیچه that wraps under the کرهٔ چشم from the front. It mainly rotates the چشم and helps it look up and out.

structures.label: Levator palpebrae superioris
structures.description: The ماهیچه that raises the فوقانی eyelid. It does not move the کرهٔ چشم.

structures.label: عصب بینایی
structures.description: Carries visual signals from the شبکیه to the مغز.

structures.label: Trochlea
structures.description: A small loop of غضروف that acts as a pulley for the زردپی of the فوقانی oblique ماهیچه.

structures.label: Lacrimal gland
structures.description: Makes the watery part of tears, which keep the front of the چشم moist and clean.

structures.label: فوقانی tarsal plate
structures.description: A firm plate of dense connective tissue that stiffens and shapes the فوقانی eyelid.

structures.label: تحتانی tarsal plate
structures.description: A firm plate of dense connective tissue that supports the تحتانی eyelid.

structures.label: مری
structures.description: A muscular tube about 25 cm long that carries swallowed food from the throat to the معده. It runs behind the نای and the قلب and passes through the دیافراگم.

structures.label: معده
structures.description: The مری ends just below the دیافراگم, which is not shown, by opening into the معده at the cardia.

structures.label: نای
structures.description: The windpipe lies directly in front of the مری in the گردن and فوقانی قفسهٔ سینه, until it divides into the two main نایژه‌ها.

structures.label: Main نایژه‌ها
structures.description: The چپ main نایژه crosses in front of the مری and presses a shallow narrowing into it.

structures.label: غدهٔ تیروئید
structures.description: Wraps around the front and sides of the نای in the تحتانی گردن, beside the start of the مری.

structures.label: دهلیز چپ
structures.description: The back of the قلب. The مری lies directly behind it, separated only by the pericardium.

structures.label: Arch of آئورت
structures.description: Curves over the چپ main نایژه, crossing the چپ سمت of the مری and leaving a narrowing where it presses on it.

structures.label: Descending آئورت
structures.description: Runs down behind and to the چپ of the مری. Near the دیافراگم the مری crosses in front of it.

structures.label: Esophageal سرخرگ‌ها
structures.description: Small branches of the آئورت that supply the thoracic part of the مری.

structures.label: تحتانی thyroid سرخرگ‌ها
structures.description: Supply the غدهٔ تیروئید and send branches to the مری in the گردن.

structures.label: چپ معدی سرخرگ
structures.description: Runs along the فوقانی curve of the معده and sends branches up to the abdominal part of the مری.

structures.label: Azygos سیاهرگ
structures.description: Runs up the راست سمت of the ستون مهره‌ها, behind the مری, and drains most of the مری in the قفسهٔ سینه.

structures.label: Hemiazygos سیاهرگ‌ها
structures.description: Run up the چپ سمت of the ستون مهره‌ها and cross behind the آئورت to join the azygos سیاهرگ.

structures.label: چپ معدی سیاهرگ
structures.description: Drains the تحتانی مری into the portal دستگاه. Its link with the azygos سیاهرگ‌ها is where esophageal varices form when portal pressure rises.

structures.label: راست vagus عصب
structures.description: Descends beside the مری, joins the esophageal plexus and passes through the hiatus mostly behind it, as the خلفی vagal trunk.

structures.label: چپ vagus عصب
structures.description: Crosses the aortic arch, then spreads over the مری and passes through the hiatus mostly in front of it, as the قدامی vagal trunk.

structures.label: Recurrent laryngeal اعصاب
structures.description: Branches of the vagus that climb back up in the groove between the نای and مری to reach the حنجره.

structures.label: Duodenum
structures.description: The first, C-shaped part of the رودهٔ باریک. It receives food from the معده along with bile and pancreatic juices.

structures.label: Jejunum
structures.description: The middle part of the رودهٔ باریک, where much of the digestion and absorption of nutrients takes place.

structures.label: Ileum
structures.description: The last part of the رودهٔ باریک. It continues absorbing nutrients and joins the رودهٔ بزرگ in the تحتانی راست شکم.

structures.label: Appendix
structures.description: A narrow, انگشت-shaped pouch that projects from the beginning of the رودهٔ بزرگ in the تحتانی راست شکم.

structures.label: Ascending colon
structures.description: Rises along the راست سمت of the شکم from the start of the رودهٔ بزرگ toward the کبد. The colon absorbs water and forms stool.

structures.label: Transverse colon
structures.description: Crosses the فوقانی شکم from راست to چپ, below the کبد and معده.

structures.label: Descending colon
structures.description: Runs down the چپ سمت of the شکم and carries stool toward the rectum.

structures.label: Rectum
structures.description: The final straight section of the رودهٔ بزرگ, in the لگن, which stores stool until it leaves the بدن through the anus.

structures.label: Mesocolic taenia
structures.description: One of three ribbon-like bands of longitudinal ماهیچه on the colon. It runs along the سمت where the colon is attached by its mesentery.

structures.label: Omental taenia
structures.description: A band of longitudinal colon ماهیچه that, on the transverse colon, runs where the greater omentum attaches.

structures.label: Free taenia
structures.description: The band of longitudinal colon ماهیچه with no attachment, visible on the front of the ascending and descending colon.

structures.label: Hyoid استخوان
structures.description: A U-shaped استخوان above the حنجره that touches no other استخوان. The حنجره hangs from it by the thyrohyoid membrane.

structures.label: Thyroid غضروف
structures.description: The largest غضروف of the حنجره. Its two plates meet at the front to form the laryngeal prominence, the Adam’s apple, and shield the vocal folds.

structures.label: Cricoid غضروف
structures.description: The only complete ring of غضروف in the airway, narrow at the front and tall at the back. It sits below the thyroid غضروف and on top of the نای.

structures.label: Epiglottis
structures.description: A leaf-shaped flap of elastic غضروف behind the زبان. It tips back over the entrance of the حنجره when you swallow.

structures.label: Arytenoid cartilages
structures.description: Two small pyramids on the back of the cricoid. The vocal ligaments attach to them, so their rocking and sliding opens and closes the vocal folds.

structures.label: Corniculate and cuneiform cartilages
structures.description: Tiny nodules of غضروف. The corniculates cap the arytenoids and the cuneiforms stiffen the aryepiglottic folds at the entrance of the حنجره.

structures.label: Thyrohyoid membrane
structures.description: A sheet that hangs the thyroid غضروف from the hyoid استخوان. It is thickened in the midline and at its back edges into the thyrohyoid ligaments.

structures.label: Median cricothyroid رباط
structures.description: Bridges the gap at the front between the thyroid and cricoid cartilages. It can be felt just below the Adam’s apple.

structures.label: Conus elasticus
structures.description: An elastic membrane rising from the cricoid toward the vocal folds. Its free فوقانی edge thickens into the vocal ligaments.

structures.label: Vocal ligaments
structures.description: Two bands running from the back of the thyroid غضروف to the arytenoids. With the vocalis ماهیچه‌ها they form the vocal folds, which vibrate to make sound.

structures.label: Epiglottic ligaments
structures.description: Tie the epiglottis forward to the hyoid استخوان and its stalk down to the inside of the thyroid غضروف.

structures.label: Cricothyroid
structures.description: The only intrinsic ماهیچه on the outside of the حنجره. It tilts the thyroid غضروف forward, stretching the vocal folds and raising the pitch of the voice.

structures.label: خلفی crico-arytenoid
structures.description: On the back of the cricoid. It is the only ماهیچه that opens the vocal folds, which keeps the airway open for breathing.

structures.label: جانبی crico-arytenoid
structures.description: Rotates the arytenoids inward to bring the vocal folds together.

structures.label: Arytenoid ماهیچه‌ها
structures.description: Span the backs of the two arytenoids. They pull the cartilages together to close the back of the glottis.

structures.label: Thyro-arytenoid
structures.description: Runs beside the vocal folds from the thyroid غضروف to the arytenoids. It shortens and relaxes the folds, lowering the pitch.

structures.label: Vocalis
structures.description: The innermost fibres of the thyro-arytenoid, lying along each vocal رباط. They fine-tune the tension of the vocal folds.

structures.label: Aryepiglottic
structures.description: Thin fibres running from the arytenoids up to the sides of the epiglottis. They help narrow the entrance of the حنجره when you swallow.

structures.label: نای
structures.description: The windpipe. It continues from the cricoid غضروف down into the قفسهٔ سینه, held open by C-shaped rings of غضروف, and divides into the two main نایژه‌ها.

structures.label: غدهٔ تیروئید
structures.description: A hormone gland wrapped around the front of the فوقانی نای. Its isthmus crosses the نای just below the cricoid غضروف.
